01 — Polvos de Sulpha · Menper

SULPHATIN
The hero that defeats the villains no one wanted

"You can't sell the product first. Sell the problem, build the habit, then differentiate."
CategoryTopical antibiotic powder ChannelAmazon USA + España · Instagram AudienceMothers 30–45 · parents with kids StageOptimization — active since Dec 2024
CVR 8% → 14% Character Universe Amazon A+ 29+ Posts 16-Week Plan
Layout:
Sulphatin v3 — The Hero
Protection doesn't panic

The Insight

A healthy CTR but stalling conversions. People arrived at the product page and couldn't see themselves in it. The product wasn't the problem — the story was missing.

The System

Built a villain-and-hero universe where the wound is the protagonist and Sulphatin is the resolution. Every post follows a narrative arc. Integrated, not decorative.

The Reach

The character system crossed from social into Amazon A+ imagery — a deliberate extension that unified the brand experience and drove measurable conversion lift.

Content Pillars

40% storytelling · 30% product use clarity · 20% social proof · 10% cultural hooks

02 — Scott's Emulsion

THE SPOON
THAT CARES
A system built from scratch for a product that already sold itself

"An ordinary spoon can be the symbol of the care a parent gives their child."
CategoryChildren's cod liver oil supplement ChannelTikTok Shop · Instagram AudienceMillennial parents · Latin families GMV$5,721.27 (Mar–Apr 2026)
$5,721 GMV 30 TikTok Hooks 9 Video Scripts Generational Storytelling TikTok Shop
Layout:
The Spoon That Cares
Wellness, passed down

The Insight

The product already had PMF — TikTok Shop generating real revenue with zero organic support. The question wasn't "does this work?" It was: how do we make it discoverable?

The Angle

No competitor worked the generational emotional space. Nordic Naturals goes clinical. Carlson goes functional. Scott's owns the only unclaimed territory: the ritual of care, passed down.

The System

30 hooks categorized by trigger: nostalgia, parental conflict, myth-breaking, curiosity. 9 video scripts in native TikTok formats. All ready to deploy.

Visual Identity

Warm wood tones · natural morning light · short depth of field. Cinematic, never commercial. The fisherman stays in the background — always detail, never protagonist.

03 — Opal Sanitizer

KANDALL
OPAL
The mascot that externalizes what the user feels internally

"Without the right character, the product disappears into wellness noise — looks like a candle, smells like perfume, sells nothing."
CategoryAromatic hand sanitizer · wellness niche VariantsCalming (lavender) · Energizing (matcha) ChannelAmazon USA · Instagram · TikTok StagePre-scale — system built
5 Content Grids 2D Mascot Design Dual IG/TikTok Strategy Trendy Wellness Chic Gap Audit
Layout:
Kandall Opal v2 — Character Sheet
Trendy Wellness Chic
↳ IMAGE PLACEHOLDERS — 2–3 product lifestyle shots needed: sanitizer bottle on warm wood surface, hands holding product, Calming vs Energizing variants side by side. Natural side light, neutral warm background.

The Problem

Swap the logo and it disappears. Without a character anchoring the brand, Opal reads as ambient wellness noise. Kandall Opal is the mechanism that makes the brand sticky.

The Character

2D illustrated mascot — "trendy wellness chic." Lavender crop, mint leggings, opal pendant. Four views for overlay versatility. Not decorative — narrative.

Dual Platform

Instagram: calm, aspirational, saves-worthy. TikTok: immediate emotional relief, 5–8s cuts, hands-only, no voiceover. Same brand, two behavioral modes.

Strategic Gaps

Part of the deliverable: documented gaps — zero CTAs to Amazon, 70% alcohol invisible, no category anchor. Diagnosing what's missing is strategy too.

04 — Bálsamo Tchakowski

FROM MYTH
TO TRADITION
A strategic pivot toward clarity that actually converts

"The Latino buying natural remedies already knows they work. They don't need convincing — they need someone to explain how to use it."
CategoryLiquid dietary supplement — multiuse IngredientsBee propolis + Vitamin E ChannelAmazon USA · Instagram · TikTok AudienceLatinos in the US — family health
Strategic Pivot Latino Market Cuban Heritage 25+ Posts Use Hierarchy
Layout:
Simple ingredients. Real care.
Remedios que perduran

"Una fórmula.
Desde adentro
hacia afuera."

The Diagnosis

Too much ambiguity. Stomach? Skin? Mouth? The content was poetic before it was useful — and confusion before purchase kills conversion.

The Pivot

From "narrative myth" to "tradition that works." Concrete Cuban heritage over evocative poetry. Digestive use first, always — skincare second, oral third. Hierarchy creates trust.

The Principle

The Latino consumer doesn't need to be convinced natural remedies work. Be useful before being beautiful. First frame must answer: what is this?

Language Call

Content was being produced primarily in English. Recommendation: pivot to Spanish to match the actual audience — Latinos in the U.S. buying in their cultural context.
